notes.title: Version 1.50 released
notes.content:
Hi folks. We'd like to let you know that we just released a new build. This build includes some new daily portal worlds (thanks for the feedback on that!) As well as some misc. bug fixes and optimizations. 

Some notes:

- You may notice some odd connectivity issues today and tomorrow, as the backend server for the game's leaderboards/daily updates has changed.

 
- We had to upgrade the underlying game engine with this update. This usually means the game runs smoother for folks, and often fixes some rare bugs; but it might also break compatibility on some much older PCs or OSs. If this is you, let us know and we'll try to help.

- Some people have reported a score exploit, as well as some suspicously high scores on the leaderboard. We've fixed the exploit in this build, and we'll be resetting the all-time and daily leaderboards tomorrow.

Also: Thanks for those who have (very) patiently been waiting for the promised VR update. This game engine upgrade was an important step towards that, and we hope to have a build ready for you very soon.

tags.feature: This build includes some new daily portal worlds

tags.bug: Some people have reported a score exploit, as well as some suspicously high scores on the leaderboard. We've fixed the exploit in this build

notes.title: Race The Sun 1.455 released
notes.content:
Hey all, thanks for your bug reports, suggestions, and patience! This build includes lots of bug fixes, as well as a few requested features.

Partial list of changes:
[list]
[*] Added "No Vsync" option
[*] Improved collision detection w/powerups
[*] Added selectable controller profiles, and slightly better controller detection, as well as a "reset" option.
[*] Added input reset hotkey: Hold C on main menu for 3 seconds.
[*] Powerups should now spawn more consistently between rounds
[*] Fixed glitch when sun goes down while holding a shield
[*] Fixed bugs where powerups from portal would still be present in main world
[*] Fixed achievement bug where certain achievements showed progress incorrectly
[*] Fix for rare crash when entering portal
[*] Upgraded Unity engine to 5.1.3, which shoudl bring some performance improvements in Linux, potentially fix some rare crashes, etc.
[*] Optimized loading time for Sunrise DLC mode.
[*] Fixed OSX icon
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.453 Released
notes.content:
Hi all! Just a heads up that we just set a new build loose.
Changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed "Error Calculating Rank" bug (for real!)
[*] Mac builds are now 64-bit.
[*] Fixed level editor lockup when using "test" button
[*] Can now create more than 25 levels in editor
[*] Improved Level Editor screen user experience
[*] Fixed engine sound for first-person mode
[*] First person setting will now persist for game session duration
[*] Fixed some issues with some portal worlds causing lock-ups
[/list]

As always, if you experience any issues, we'd appreciate bug reports:
http://flippfly.freshdesk.com/support/tickets/new

And lastly - just a reminder that we launched the Sunrise DLC last week, which you can see [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/378731/]here.[/url]

notes.title: Sunrise DLC for Race The Sun is here!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

[i]First, before I get into the good stuff, let me just officially introduce myself. My name is Drew and I am the new Flippfly Community & Customer Support Manager. This means you'll start to see me join discussions and post announcements like these. Don't worry, I'm sure you'll still hear from Aaron and Forest some, too.

I'm also the first person you speak with over at our [url=http://flippfly.freshdesk.com/]support forum[/url] and through our primary [url=https://twitter.com/Flippfly]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/Flippfly]Facebook[/url] accounts. I will be lurking everywhere. ...But enough about me![/i]

[h1][url=http://store.steampowered.com/dlc/253030/]Sunrise DLC[/url][/h1]

[img=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CK8c8frWwAAjFVd.png:large][/img]

For some time, our players have been asking for a "zen" type mode for Race The Sun. And we’ve been listening! Today we launched a $1.99 DLC here on Steam, called [url=http://store.steampowered.com/dlc/253030/]Sunrise[/url]. This beautiful new mode has all the speed of the original but without a setting sun, an increasing difficulty, or a leaderboard. Just settle in and zone out for one infinite region of bliss. [url=http://store.steampowered.com/dlc/253030/]Go check it out![/url]

We’re looking forward to hear what you think! Please leave us your comments!

[h1]RTS Update[/h1]

Along with this newly available DLC, we have also made some updates to the game including new features we think you're going to love!

[list]
[*] First-Person Camera Mode: at the press of a button ("c" on your keyboard by default) race with a cockpit view from within the ship!
[*] Friend's Highscores in the Sky: now you can literally see yourself passing your friend’s scores without leaving the main course!
[/list]

We're very excited about these updates and hope you are, too! Please let us know what you think of the new features.

And I look forward to talking with you in the Discussions section. If you ever experience any strange behavior with Race The Sun or need help with your Flippfly account or other Flippfly products, please head over to our [url=http://flippfly.freshdesk.com/]support forum[/url] and I will see what I can do for you.

You can also say hello to us via [url=https://twitter.com/Flippfly]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/Flippfly]Facebook[/url].

Until next time,
— Drew

Race The Sun Fan + Flippfly Community & Customer Support Manager

notes.title: New Version: 1.44
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce that a new version is available!

- Labyrintha mode: A new (not endless!) mode for players who complete level 25.
- Improved controller support: XBox360 and PS3/PS4 controllers will now be automatically detected, and show custom icons in the UI
- Added AlienFX support for Alienware PCs
- Restored the "woosh" sound when passing buildings, as well as the ship engine sounds.
- Misc. bug fixes
(Note: Oculus Rift support will be coming in the next update!)

notes.title: Workshop beta now available!
notes.content:
Workshop support is now available in a 'beta' build of Race The Sun.

For players who'd like to join in, here's how:
1. Opt into the beta, in the game properties (see 'betas' tab)
2. Join the following beta group for access to workshop:
http://steamcommunity.com/groups/rts_workshop

Please use the community forums here for feedback:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/253030/discussions

notes.title: Linux & Workshop Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Race the Sun includes the Simplex World Creator for making your own custom worlds, and we are in the process of adding Steam Workshop support. With Workshop you will be able to rate and play other player-created worlds, as well as share your own. We will also be tying the in-game world portals (the big green ones) to the best user-created worlds! When this is all set up, flying into a portal could take you anywhere!

Soon we will be opening up a beta version with Workshop support, so be on the lookout for that announcement.

We are also finishing up the Linux version of Race the Sun for Steam - just a few bugs to work out and it will be ready.

[i]Thank you all for your thoughts and feedback as we update, fix and improve Race the Sun![/i]

- The Flippfly Team
